title: Siren and the Bell
description: A blue-skinned demonic female with black horns and glowing tattoos emerges from a cracked stone archway, holding a large glowing golden bell chained to her wrist. In the foreground, a blonde woman in a blue and black corset dress stands in swirling ocean waves surrounded by white lilies and floating open books.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene featuring a blue-skinned female demon with curved black horns and intricate glowing tattoos, emerging from a broken gothic stone archway with ocean waves crashing through. She holds a large glowing golden bell with magical sound waves emanating from it, chained to her wrist. In the foreground, a beautiful blonde woman wearing a blue and black corseted dress stands in turbulent blue water, surrounded by floating white lilies and open books with pages turning in the wind. Night sky with constellations and glowing orbs in the background, highly detailed digital painting.
